svg.title: Modbus TCP frame anatomy – FC03 request and response, captured from the virtual plant – drawing 53-04
svg.text: Modbus TCP frame anatomy – FC03 request and response, captured from the virtual plant
FMS controller reads the FAST block (registers 0 – 11) of HMC-01, unit id 1, transaction 0x0101 · all values big-endian
MBAP header (7 bytes): transaction id (client counts, server copies),
protocol id 0 = Modbus, length = bytes that follow (unit + PDU),
unit id (1 for every device of this plant; matters only behind
an RTU gateway). PDU = function code + data (max 253 bytes).
Decoded: map V1.2 (0x0102), type 1 = CNC, unit 1, heartbeat 8,
status 2 = bit 1 IDLE, mode 1 = auto, state 1 = IDLE, no alarm,
hs.status 0x0010 = bit 4 READY → may receive a job.
Size formulas: request 12 bytes; response 9 + 2n bytes;
on the wire (thesis Eq. 5.1): b(n) = 261 + 2n bytes per poll
→ b(12) = 285 bytes incl. TCP/IP/Ethernet + ACK frame.
